description: Home screen restructure + behaviors. Owns ALL dashboard_page.dart edits (tasks 1, 4-header, 5, 7-cards, 10, 11, 6-trigger, 12) so no two FEATs edit the same file. Removes the ذكر اليوم section, makes محاسبة اليوم a FAB, adds the Ramadan-2027 countdown card, adds المساجد to the bottom nav, makes the home header + feature cards + quick chips glassy (uses GlassCard from FEAT-002), gates the azkar reminder to post-dashboard, and fixes English worship keys. Depends on FEAT-002's GlassCard. Files: lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_page.dart, lib/widgets/ramadan_countdown_widget.dart (NEW), lib/services/azkar_reminder_service.dart, lib/main.dart, lib/services/daily_summary_service.dart.
steps: lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_page.dart — Remove the 'ذكر اليوم' block (task 1): delete the sliver `if (_showAzkar) ...[ _SectionTitle('ذكر اليوم'), _buildRotatingAzkar ] else _buildAzkarSettingsButton`. Remove the `_showAzkar`/`_showAzkarPrefKey` field, `_loadAzkarPref`/`_setShowAzkar` methods, the `_loadAzkarPref()` call in initState, and the now-unused `_buildRotatingAzkar`/`_buildAzkarSettingsButton` methods. Then grep `azkarCategories` and `Dhikr` in this file; if their only uses were inside `_buildRotatingAzkar`, remove the now-unused import (avoid an analyzer unused-import warning). Do NOT touch `_HomeDhikrCounterCard` (the separate quick tasbih counter).

Same file — Glassy home header (task 4 header part): wrap the header SliverToBoxAdapter Container content in a Stack inside a ClipRRect (keep the bottom-left/right radius 36): base green gradient Container + BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur(sigma ~10)) over a translucent white Container(alpha ~0.06) + a subtle white Border + the existing header Column. Header stays green but frosted/glassy.

Same file — Move محاسبة اليوم to a FAB (task 5): delete the sliver block `if (!isGuest) ...[ _SectionTitle('محاسبة اليوم'), _buildDailyAccountability ]`. Remove `_buildDailyAccountability` and the now-unused `_SuccessCard`/`_AccountabilityCard` classes (grep to confirm no other refs). Add a `floatingActionButton` to the Scaffold, shown only when `!isGuest`: wrap a `FloatingActionButton.extended` (icon Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded, label 'محاسبة اليوم' via _f, backgroundColor AppColors.darkGreen, onPressed () => _showAccountabilityDialog(isDark)) in `Padding(EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 96))` so it clears the MiniPlayer + _ModernNavBar. Keep `_showAccountabilityDialog`, `_saveQuickAccountability`, `_checkTodayAccountability`, `_CheckItem` and the five checkbox state fields. Optionally tint the FAB AppColors.gold when _isAccountabilityDone.

Same file — Glassy feature cards + quick chips (task 7 dashboard part): restyle `_FeatureCard` and `_QuickChip` to use GlassCard (import 'package:.../widgets/glass_card.dart') — frosted translucent fill + subtle white border + blur, keeping the colored icon and label and the InkWell tap ripple.

Create lib/widgets/ramadan_countdown_widget.dart (task 10): a StatefulWidget computing days remaining to DateTime(2027, 2, 8). Luxury card: dark-green/gold LinearGradient, subtle Islamic-geometric pattern via stacked Container decorations, moon/star Icons in gold, tagline 'انتظرونا مع مزايا مميزة في رمضان القادم', dua 'اللهم بلغنا رمضان في عفو وعافية', prominent gold days-remaining number. Share button: RepaintBoundary + GlobalKey -> boundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3) -> png -> getTemporaryDirectory() -> Share.shareXFiles([XFile(path)], text: ...). Use AppColors + GoogleFonts.ibmPlexSansArabic, RTL.

Same dashboard file — Insert the Ramadan card (task 10): add a SliverToBoxAdapter with _SectionTitle('قريباً... رمضان 2027', icon: Icons.nights_stay_rounded) followed by the new RamadanCountdownWidget (import it), placed right after the _buildLastReadQuranCard sliver.

Same file — Add المساجد to the bottom nav (task 11): in `_ModernNavBar` insert a sixth `_NavButton(icon: Icons.mosque_rounded, label: 'المساجد', selected: currentIndex == 5, onTap: () => NearbyMosquesPage.show(context))` after 'القبلة' and before the profile/login button. NearbyMosquesPage is already imported.

lib/services/azkar_reminder_service.dart (task 6): add `static bool _userEnteredApp = false;` and a public `void markUserEnteredApp() { _userEnteredApp = true; }`; add `if (!_userEnteredApp) return;` at the top of checkAndShowReminder (before the time-window check).

lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_page.dart initState (task 6): after `super.initState();` add `AzkarReminderService().markUserEnteredApp();` and `WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => AzkarReminderService().checkAndShowReminder());`. (AzkarReminderService is already imported in main.dart; add the import to dashboard_page.dart if missing.)

lib/main.dart (task 6): in `_BasairAppState.initState` REMOVE the `WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) { Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2500), () { AzkarReminderService().checkAndShowReminder(); }); });` block. Keep `AzkarReminderService.navigatorKey = appNavigatorKey;` and keep the resume trigger in `didChangeAppLifecycleState` (it is now gated by the _userEnteredApp flag).

lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_page.dart `_getWorshipDisplayName` (task 12): add missing cases — `case 'fajr_prayed': return 'صلاة الفجر';`, `case 'fajr_woke_alarm': return 'الاستيقاظ لصلاة الفجر';`, `case 'evening_azkar_done': return 'أذكار المساء';` (verify quran_read/azkar_done/istighfar_done/charity already map; add any that are missing).

lib/services/daily_summary_service.dart `_getWorshipDisplayName` (task 12): this helper is missing most keys — add cases for `fajr_prayed`->'صلاة الفجر', `fajr_woke_alarm`->'الاستيقاظ لصلاة الفجر', `quran_read`->'قراءة القرآن', `azkar_done`->'الأذكار', `evening_azkar_done`->'أذكار المساء', `istighfar_done`->'الاستغفار', mirroring the dashboard helper, so the daily-summary text shows Arabic instead of raw keys.
acceptance_criteria: `flutter analyze` reports 0 errors after this FEAT.
The home screen no longer shows a 'ذكر اليوم' section; the quick tasbih counter still works.
Logged-in users see a small 'محاسبة اليوم' floating button that opens the accountability dialog; guests do not see it.
A luxury 'قريباً... رمضان 2027' countdown card appears near the top of the home list and its share button exports a PNG.
The bottom nav includes 'المساجد' which opens the nearby-mosques sheet.
The home header, feature cards, and quick-access chips render as frosted glass (using GlassCard).
The morning/evening azkar reminder does NOT appear on splash/onboarding; it appears only once the dashboard is shown (guest or user).
Under 'العبادات الأخرى' in the daily summary, fajr_prayed shows as 'صلاة الفجر' and fajr_woke_alarm as 'الاستيقاظ لصلاة الفجر' — never the English keys.
verification: Run `flutter analyze` from e:/NiyyahTracker-mobile-app-ai and confirm 0 errors (clean up any unused-import/decl warnings this FEAT introduces).

Run the app: confirm the home screen has no ذكر اليوم section, the محاسبة اليوم FAB appears for logged-in users and opens the dialog, the Ramadan countdown card is present and shareable, the bottom nav has المساجد, the header/cards are glassy, and (within morning/evening windows) the azkar reminder appears only after reaching the dashboard. Log a fajr_prayed/fajr_woke_alarm entry and confirm the daily summary shows Arabic labels.
